tracesTo: SOW: Commissioner Desk & Weekly Content Publishing
UserFlow: Weekly Commissioner Desk → Optional Content Creation & Publishing to Feed

stories.title: Execute Single Publish Action for All Weekly Content
stories.goal: publish all completed weekly content (power rankings, matchup of the week, predictions) with a single unified publish action
stories.benefit: I can efficiently share all my weekly content with the league in one operation without multiple publish steps
acceptanceCriteria: System provides single 'Publish All' button that triggers publishing for all non-skipped content sections atomically
Publish operation validates all non-skipped sections before execution and displays specific validation errors
Single transaction updates power rankings page, matchup page, predictions database, and creates all feed moments simultaneously
If any part of publish operation fails, system rolls back entire transaction and displays detailed error message
System displays progress indicator during publish operation showing each step being completed
Success confirmation displays summary of what was published with direct links to view content on respective pages and in feed

stories.title: Create Feed Moments for Published Content
stories.goal: automatically generate separate feed moments for each type of published weekly content
stories.benefit: my content is immediately visible in the league newsfeed without manual posting
acceptanceCriteria: System creates distinct feed moment for power rankings with preview of top 3 teams and link to full rankings page
System creates feed moment for matchup of the week featuring the highlighted matchup with hype text and predictions
System creates feed moment for commissioner predictions displaying all predictions made for the week
Each feed moment includes publication timestamp, commissioner attribution, and appropriate content preview
Feed moments are inserted at top of newsfeed timeline in chronological order of content type (rankings, matchup, predictions)
System only creates feed moments for non-skipped content sections
Feed moments support standard engagement features (comments, reactions) immediately upon creation

stories.title: Update Power Rankings Page on Publish
stories.goal: view the newly published power rankings on the dedicated power rankings page immediately after commissioner publishes
stories.benefit: I can see the latest team rankings and commissioner commentary as soon as they're published
acceptanceCriteria: Power rankings page displays newly published rankings immediately after publish operation completes
Page shows correct week and season context with rankings ordered 1-N as specified by commissioner
Each team displays rank position, team name/logo, and commissioner commentary
Page includes publication timestamp and 'Published by [Commissioner Name]' attribution
Week selector on rankings page updates to show new week as 'Published' with green indicator
Historical rankings trajectory chart updates to include new week's data points for all teams

stories.title: Update Matchups Page with Featured Matchup
stories.goal: see the featured matchup of the week highlighted on the matchups page immediately after publishing
stories.benefit: I can quickly identify which game is the most important to watch this week
acceptanceCriteria: Matchups page displays featured matchup with special visual styling (highlighted border, 'Matchup of the Week' badge)
Featured matchup shows both teams, hype text from commissioner, and commissioner's prediction
System positions featured matchup at top of matchup list for the selected week regardless of schedule order
Matchup displays commissioner prediction with clear indication of predicted winner and confidence level
Page updates immediately after publish with no cache delays or manual refresh required
Featured matchup is accessible via direct link from feed moment for easy navigation

stories.title: Store Commissioner Predictions for Grading
stories.goal: persist all commissioner predictions in database for post-stat-correction grading after matchups complete
stories.benefit: predictions can be automatically graded and stats calculated after official results are finalized
acceptanceCriteria: System stores each prediction with matchup ID, predicted winner team ID, confidence level, and commissioner user ID
Predictions are associated with specific week and season for accurate grading context
Database schema includes prediction status field (pending, graded, stat-corrected) for tracking
System stores prediction timestamp and publication week for historical analysis
Predictions remain immutable after publication to ensure grading integrity
Schema supports storing optional prediction commentary or reasoning from commissioner

stories.title: Detect NFL Stat Corrections via Data Sync
stories.goal: automatically detect when NFL stat corrections occur that may change fantasy matchup outcomes
stories.benefit: predictions and pick'ems can be graded with official final scores after corrections
acceptanceCriteria: System monitors Sleeper API for stat correction events via scheduled data synchronization (every 4 hours during season)
Stat correction detection compares previous matchup scores with updated scores from external platform
System identifies affected matchups where score changes resulted in winner changes (score differential flipped)
Detection logs all stat correction events with timestamp, affected matchup IDs, score changes, and winner changes
System flags affected weeks as 'pending regrading' when stat corrections detected within 72 hours of matchup completion
Notification is sent to commissioners when stat corrections affect published predictions or pick'ems

stories.title: Automatically Grade Commissioner Predictions After Stat Corrections
stories.goal: grade all commissioner predictions with official final results after stat correction window closes
stories.benefit: commissioner prediction stats are accurate and reflect true outcomes
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically grades predictions 72 hours after matchup completion (standard stat correction window)
Grading process compares commissioner's predicted winner with actual matchup winner from Sleeper API
System marks predictions as 'correct' or 'incorrect' and stores grading timestamp
Grading handles regrading when stat corrections occur, updating previous grades with 'regraded' flag
System calculates weekly commissioner prediction accuracy (correct predictions / total predictions)
Grading updates commissioner's cumulative season and all-time prediction stats automatically
System displays grading status on predictions feed moment as 'Grading pending', 'Graded', or 'Regraded'

stories.title: Update Commissioner Prediction Stats and Leaderboards
stories.goal: view updated commissioner prediction statistics after weekly grading completes
stories.benefit: I can see how accurate the commissioner's predictions have been over time
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains commissioner prediction stats table with weekly, season, and all-time records
Stats include total predictions, correct predictions, incorrect predictions, and accuracy percentage
Prediction stats appear on commissioner profile or stats page with visual accuracy indicators
System updates leaderboard comparing commissioner accuracy with other league member pick'ems performance
Stats display confidence-weighted accuracy for predictions with confidence levels (future enhancement)
Historical prediction data is preserved for all past seasons with dynasty league continuity
System displays 'Stats updated' timestamp to show freshness of graded data

stories.title: Handle Republishing with Updated Content
stories.goal: update already-published content and republish with clear indication of changes
stories.benefit: I can correct errors or add information after initial publication without confusing league members
acceptanceCriteria: System allows editing of published content which creates new draft version while preserving original
Republish action updates all affected pages and feed moments with new content atomically
Feed moments display 'Updated' badge with update timestamp to indicate content was modified post-publication
System maintains version history showing original publication and all subsequent updates with change tracking
Updated power rankings trigger regrading of predictions if rankings materially changed (future enhancement)
Republish only bumps feed moments if changes exceed configured significance threshold (e.g., commentary changes)
System notifies league members via optional notification when significant updates are republished

stories.title: Display Publishing Status and History
stories.goal: view complete history of when content was published, updated, and graded for any week
stories.benefit: I can track my content publishing activity and verify grading occurred correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Commissioner Desk displays publishing timeline showing publish date, republish dates, and grading completion dates
Each week shows status badges: 'Published', 'Grading Pending', 'Graded', 'Stat Corrected & Regraded'
System provides detailed publish history modal with timestamps, publisher user, and content versions
Grading status section shows prediction accuracy for the week and grading timestamp
Publishing history is filterable by season and content type (rankings, matchups, predictions)
System displays audit trail for troubleshooting: publish attempts, failures, rollbacks, and retries

stories.title: Validate Content Completeness Before Publishing
stories.goal: receive clear validation errors if required content is missing or invalid before attempting to publish
stories.benefit: I avoid failed publish attempts and can complete all required content efficiently
acceptanceCriteria: Publish button is disabled with tooltip explaining missing requirements when content is incomplete
System validates power rankings have all teams ranked with no gaps or duplicates (if not skipped)
System validates matchup of the week has team selection, hype text, and prediction (if not skipped)
System validates all predictions have winner selected for non-skipped matchups
Validation displays specific error messages with links to incomplete sections for quick navigation
System allows partial publish if some sections are explicitly skipped via 'Skip This Week' toggle
Pre-publish validation preview shows exactly what will be published before confirmation

stories.title: Rollback Failed Publish Operations
stories.goal: have the system automatically rollback all changes if any part of the publish operation fails
stories.benefit: my content remains in draft state if publish fails rather than being partially published
acceptanceCriteria: System wraps entire publish operation in database transaction to ensure atomicity
If feed moment creation fails, system rolls back page updates and database changes
If page update fails, system rolls back feed moments and reverts publish status to draft
System logs detailed error information for debugging failed publish attempts
Failed publish displays user-friendly error message with specific failure reason and retry option
Content remains in draft state after rollback with no partial data visible to league members
System sends error notification to technical admin for investigation of persistent failures
